integrity: Dimension-free Hilbert Cauchy–Schwarz reduction, exact one-variable maximization, attained collinear extremal witnesses, rigorous uniform asymptotic tail control. Numerical checker supplements the proof and is not an infinite-dimensional certificate. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real, two-block Hilbert-valued p-sums only, 1<p<infinity; no claims for nonsmooth endpoints, complex scalars, non-Hilbert fibers or three-plus summands. Full text of the 2018 global approximate-symmetry predecessor was not available for comparison.
title: Sharp \(C\)-symmetry of two Hilbert summands and its near-Hilbert slope
